headline: Shimano Raises Full-Year Profit Guidance After Strong Third Quarter
summary: Shimano raised its full-year profit guidance following a stronger-than-expected third-quarter financial performance.
why: Shimano is a global leader in bicycle components and fishing tackle, serving as a key bellwether for consumer discretionary demand in outdoor sports equipment.

impacts.name: Shimano Inc.
impacts.why: Upgrading profit forecasts reflects stronger consumer demand and margin expansion.
